title: WynnDialogueSkip
body:
![Wynncraft Dialogue Skipper](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/447b27b0dd96dff0901c7fd5cde15d121e53d7aa.gif) *Enhances your Wynncraft experience by automatically skipping NPC dialogue, allowing for faster questing and a more streamlined gameplay flow.* > 💡 *This mod is designed for players who are already familiar with Wynncraft's quests and want to speed up repetitive conversations. If you are a new player, I highly recommend reading the dialogue and immersing yourself in the lore :)*
View Mod Features (Click to Expand) * **Automatic Dialogue Skipping:** The mod detects when you're in a dialogue with an NPC and automatically presses your designated skip key, moving the conversation forward without any input from you. * **Smart and Responsive:** Designed to be unobtrusive. It only activates when it detects that dialogue can be progressed, and it respects your in-game keybindings to ensure a seamless experience. * **In-Game Configuration:** Using the Mod Menu, you can easily customize the mod's behavior to your liking: * **Enable/Disable:** Quickly toggle the mod on or off without needing to restart your game. * **Adjustable Skip Delay:** Fine-tune the delay before the mod skips the dialogue. You can set it to be very fast for maximum speed, or add a slight delay if you still want to skim the text. * **Skip During Animation:** For those who want to go even faster, you can enable an option to skip dialogue even while the text is still being animated on the screen.

![Showcase of mod](https://i.imgur.com/7VbHgTo.gif) --- To use this mod, ensure you have the following installed: * **Fabric API:** A necessary library for most Fabric mods. * **Wynntils:** This mod is designed to work closely with Wynntils and *will not function without it*. * **Cloth Config API:** Required to power the in-game configuration menu. * **Mod Menu:** Required to access and use the in-game configuration menu.
